canonical_definition: VQAv2 refers to the Visual Question Answering v2 benchmark, a dataset and task format designed to assess vision-language understanding through open-ended question answering about images. It evaluates a model's ability to comprehend visual content and generate accurate answers to natural language questions, with variants emphasizing general, academic, open-world, or daily-life contexts. Some papers frame it as a k-shot evaluation or highlight its role as a standard benchmark for multimodal models.
